intro: Just like the regal peacock, the Pavo bed is a statement of beauty and strength. Its elegant design, dual-tone finish, and smart storage transform your bedroom into a sanctuary of style and ease.

features.title: Peacock-themed design for timeless beauty
features.text: The peacock symbolizes grace, confidence, and charm—everything this bed brings to your space. Its intricate design is an expression of elegance that soothes and inspires.

features.title: Dual-toned color for modern charm
features.text: The carefully chosen dual-tone color scheme blends seamlessly into contemporary bedrooms, adding a pop of sophistication and versatility to your décor.

features.title: Slide-out and half-hydraulic storage
features.text: With a combination of slide-out drawers and half-hydraulic storage, accessing your belongings is effortless—because beauty should never come at the cost of convenience.

features.title: Stain and scratch resistance for long-lasting elegance
features.text: Life happens, but your bed stays flawless. With its stain and scratch-resistant finish, Pavo is built to withstand everyday wear while maintaining its elegant allure.

features.title: Metal understructure for sturdy support
features.text: The strong metal understructure offers unmatched durability and stability, ensuring the bed stands strong for years, supporting your comfort with ease.

name: Pavo Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Pull Out Storage
